2607.21016.title: CultureTalk-ID: A Multi-Task Dialogue Benchmark for Cultural Commonsense in Indonesian Local Languages
2607.21016.paper_summary: Culture is lived through conversation, yet existing Indonesian cultural commonsense benchmarks evaluate LLMs on short and isolated prompts, stripping away the dialogic context in which cultural nuances actually surface. We introduce CultureTalk-ID, the first dialogue-based benchmark for cultural commonsense in Indonesian and its local languages, comprising 4,496 culturally grounded dialogues across 11 languages and 13 culturally salient topics, curated through a multi-stage human pipeline with native speakers to ensure authenticity. CultureTalk-ID introduces three complementary tasks, namely dialogue-based multiple-choice cultural commonsense reasoning, culturally faithful machine translation, and language steering, which jointly probe whether LLMs can understand, transfer, and generate culturally grounded language.
2607.21016.paper_summary_zh: 文化是透過對話來體驗的，但現有的印尼文化常識基準在評估大型語言模型時，僅使用短而孤立的提示，剝奪了文化細微差別實際出現的對話背景。我們推出了CultureTalk-ID，這是第一個針對印尼及其地方語言的文化常識對話基準，包含了4,496個基於文化的對話，涵蓋11種語言和13個文化重要主題，通過多階段的人力流程與母語者進行策劃，以確保真實性。CultureTalk-ID引入了三個互補任務，即基於對話的多選文化常識推理、文化忠實的機器翻譯以及語言引導，這些任務共同探討大型語言模型是否能理解、轉換和生成基於文化的語言。
2607.21016.author: Muhammad Dehan Al Kautsar et.al.
